newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Blue chips slide further on Nigerian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips slide further on Nigerian bourse.

text.p: Blue chip shares lost heavily on the Nigerian stock exchange on Thursday with no let-up of selling pressure, dealers said.
However the stock exchange said the all-share index rose to 7972.63 from 7970.06 on Wednesday.
African Petroleum was down 90 kobo to 46.90 naira and Unipetrol fell 65 kobo to 60.30 naira. Total was 20 kobo lower at 53.60 naira while Agip slid to 11.50 naira, 50 kobo down.
Conglomerates PZ Industries at 22.00 naira and Lever Brothers at 21.80 naira were 50 kobo and 40 kobo lower respectively.
Falling food companies included Nigerian Bottling Compnay, 30 kobo weaker at 47.00 naira and Cadbury, which ended 19 kobo weaker at 30.00 naira.
Guaranty Trust Bank was 20 kobo down at 4.60 naira.
Of the gainers, insurance sector newcomer Cornerstone rose five kobo to 2.65 naira while United Nigeria Textiles added 10 kobo to climb to 6.80 naira.
